en: Multiview color postcard showing sights of the Hungarian city of Pécs. The upper images depict sections of medieval stone fortifications with round towers and an arched entrance. The lower left image shows the front of the Romanesque Pécs Cathedral with its four towers and a large statue standing in the square before it. The lower right image shows a full‑figure bronze statue of a man in a coat in a park setting. The reverse side has standard postcard address lines and Hungarian printing information, including the city name PÉCS and publisher details.
